      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>
    </div>

    <nav class="work-threads__filters" aria-label="Work thread filters">
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter active" href="/work?state=open">Open work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=done">Completed</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=all">All work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=agents">Owned by agents</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=boards">Boards only</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <details class="work-threads__guide">
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>

  <header class="work-threads__header">
    <div>
      <span class="work-threads__eyebrow">Workspace work</span>
      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>
    </div>

    <nav class="work-threads__filters" aria-label="Work thread filters">
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=open">Open work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter active" href="/work?state=done">Completed</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=all">All work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=agents">Owned by agents</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=boards">Boards only</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <details class="work-threads__guide">
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>

      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>
    </div>

    <nav class="work-threads__filters" aria-label="Work thread filters">

      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=done">Completed</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter active" href="/work?state=all">All work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=agents">Owned by agents</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=boards">Boards only</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <details class="work-threads__guide">
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>

      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>

  <details class="work-threads__guide">
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>

      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>
    </div>

    <nav class="work-threads__filters" aria-label="Work thread filters">
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=open">Open work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=done">Completed</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=all">All work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=agents">Owned by agents</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter active" href="/work?state=boards">Boards only</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <details class="work-threads__guide">
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>

      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>
    </div>

    <nav class="work-threads__filters" aria-label="Work thread filters">

      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=all">All work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=agents">Owned by agents</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=boards">Boards only</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <details class="work-threads__guide">
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>

  <header class="work-threads__header">
    <div>
      <span class="work-threads__eyebrow">Workspace work</span>
      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>
    </div>

    <nav class="work-threads__filters" aria-label="Work thread filters">
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter active" href="/work?state=open">Open work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=done">Completed</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=all">All work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=agents">Owned by agents</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=boards">Boards only</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <details class="work-threads__guide" open>
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>


    <p class="work-threads__empty">

</section>

      <span class="work-threads__eyebrow">Workspace work</span>
      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>
    </div>

    <nav class="work-threads__filters" aria-label="Work thread filters">

      <a class="btn work-threads__filter active" href="/work?state=done">Completed</a>

      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=agents">Owned by agents</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=boards">Boards only</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <details class="work-threads__guide" open>
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>

      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>
    </div>

    <nav class="work-threads__filters" aria-label="Work thread filters">

      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=all">All work</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter active" href="/work?state=agents">Owned by agents</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=boards">Boards only</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <details class="work-threads__guide" open>
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>

      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>

  <details class="work-threads__guide" open>
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>

rows.body:
Workspace work

Work threads

A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.

Open work Completed All work Owned by agents Boards only
How to start a work thread
  1. Open a channel and choose Threads in the channel header.
  2. Open an existing thread, or choose New thread to start one from scratch or from a message.
  3. In the thread, open Manage and choose Track as work. The thread starts as Planned.
  4. Use Update work to assign an owner from the channel and move it through In progress, Blocked, and Done.

The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.

      <h1 id="work-threads-title">Work threads</h1>
      <p>A work thread is a channel thread with a status and an owner. This list gathers tracked work from every channel you belong to, so you can pick it back up without searching through archived threads.</p>

    <nav class="work-threads__filters" aria-label="Work thread filters">

      <a class="btn work-threads__filter active" href="/work?state=agents">Owned by agents</a>
      <a class="btn work-threads__filter" href="/work?state=boards">Boards only</a>
    </nav>
  </header>

  <details class="work-threads__guide">
  <summary>How to start a work thread</summary>
  <ol>
      <li>Open a channel and choose <strong>Threads</strong> in the channel header.</li>
      <li>Open an existing thread, or choose <strong>New thread</strong> to start one from scratch or from a message.</li>
    <li>In the thread, open <strong>Manage</strong> and choose <strong>Track as work</strong>. The thread starts as <strong>Planned</strong>.</li>
    <li>Use <strong>Update work</strong> to assign an owner from the channel and move it through <strong>In progress</strong>, <strong>Blocked</strong>, and <strong>Done</strong>.</li>
  </ol>
  <p>The person who started the thread, the channel's creator, or an administrator can turn tracking on and assign an owner. The assigned owner can update the status. Completing work keeps the conversation and its history.</p>
</details>

      <dialog id="keyboard-shortcuts" class="shortcuts-sheet" aria-labelledby="shortcuts-title"
        data-keyboard-shortcuts-target="helpDialog"
        data-action="click->keyboard-shortcuts#dismissBackdrop">
  <div class="shortcuts-sheet__surface">
    <header class="shortcuts-sheet__header">
      <h2 id="shortcuts-title">Keyboard shortcuts</h2>
      <form method="dialog">
        <button class="btn shortcuts-sheet__close" aria-label="Close shortcuts">
          <img aria-hidden="true" src="/assets/remove-0e7a045d.svg" width="16" height="16" />
        </button>
      </form>
    </header>

    <div class="shortcuts-sheet__groups">
      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-navigate-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-navigate-title">Navigate</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> / <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd></dt><dd>Quick switcher</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>/</kbd> or <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>F</kbd> / <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>F</kbd></dt><dd>Search</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd> in search</dt><dd>Pick a recent search</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd></dt><dd>Previous / next room</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Alt</kbd> <kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd></dt><dd>Previous / next unread room</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Esc</kbd></dt><dd>Mark current room read</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>?</kbd></dt><dd>This help</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-sidebar-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-sidebar-title">Sidebar rooms</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt>Right-click</dt><dd>Room menu (favourites, mute, categories)</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>F10</kbd> or <kbd>☰</kbd></dt><dd>Room menu from the keyboard</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-messages-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-messages-title">Messages</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd></dt><dd>Move between messages</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd></dt><dd>First / last message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>F10</kbd> or <kbd>☰</kbd></dt><dd>Message menu</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd> in a menu</dt><dd>Move between menu items</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Esc</kbd> in a menu</dt><dd>Close the menu</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-composer-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-composer-title">Composer</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>Send message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>New line</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> in an empty composer</dt><dd>Edit your last message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>Send message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>B</kbd> / <kbd>I</kbd></dt><dd>Bold / italic</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-pickers-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-pickers-title">Pickers and panels</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> in the emoji picker</dt><dd>Switch emoji tabs</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd> in the Drive picker</dt><dd>Choose and insert a file</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Esc</kbd></dt><dd>Close members, threads and menus</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>
    </div>

    <p class="shortcuts-sheet__note">Shortcuts never fire while typing, unless chorded with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>, <kbd>⌘</kbd> or <kbd>Alt</kbd>. <kbd>Esc</kbd> closes open dialogs, menus and panels first, and marks the current room read when nothing is open.</p>
  </div>
</dialog>
